title: Brown Butter Bakery-Style Mini M&M Cookies Thick, bakery-style cookie...
description: Brown Butter Bakery-Style Mini M&M Cookies Thick, bakery-style cookies featuring nutty brown butter, a blend of sugars, and plenty of M&M's and chocolate chunks. Prep: 45m Cook: 13m Total: 58m  Serves: 12 Ingredients: Brown Butter 227g (1 cup) salted butter Wet Ingredients 220g (1 cup packed) light brown sugar 100g (½ cup) granulated sugar 1 large egg, room temperature 2 large egg yolk, room temperature 2 teaspoons vanilla extract 45g whole milk Dry Ingredients 360g (3 cups) all-purpose flour 15g (2 tablespoons) cornstarch 10g (2 tablespoons) nonfat dry milk powder (optional, but highly recommended for bakery flavor) 1 teaspoon baking powder ¾ teaspoon baking soda ½ teaspoon fine sea salt (since we’re using salted butter) Mix-Ins 200g Mini M&M’s Instructions: 1. Brown the butter 2. Place the butter in a light-colored saucepan over medium heat. Stir frequently until it foams, then turns golden brown with little brown bits on the bottom and smells nutty. Pour immediately into a bowl, scraping in all the browned bits. Allow it to cool for about 30–45 minutes, until it has thickened to the consistency of softened butter. (You can refrigerate briefly if needed.) 3. Mix the dough 4. Beat together butter and sugars. Mix for about 2–3 minutes, until smooth and creamy. Add egg, egg yolks, and vanilla. Mix until fully combined. 5. Combine dry ingredients 6. Whisk together flour, cornstarch, milk powder, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Fold the dry ingredients into the wet ingredients just until almost combined. 7. Add the chocolate 8. Fold in Mini M&M’s and chopped chocolate. Mix just until evenly distributed. Do not overmix. 9. Chill 10. Cover and refrigerate overnight (12–24 hours). This step is one of the biggest secrets to thick bakery cookies. 11. Scoop 12. Portion into cookies. Instead of rolling smooth balls, shape them into tall cylinders (slightly taller than they are wide). Press extra Mini M&M’s over the tops. Freeze the shaped cookies for 20 minutes while the oven preheats. 13. Bake 14. Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 11–13 minutes. The cookies should look lightly golden around the edges and slightly underdone in the center. Do not overbake. 15. Bakery Finish 16. As soon as they come out, swirl with a large round cookie cutter or bowl to make perfectly round cookies. Press on a few more Mini M&M’s anywhere the tops look sparse. Let cool on the baking sheet for 10–15 minutes before moving. Notes: Chilling the dough overnight is essential for the thick, bakery-style texture. #recipe #mandm #cookie #fyp #chocolate
